why: Every edit is named exactly, and the int tests are good, but the step changes which stores the invoice job serves, drops a credit-note call, and makes three owner saves (company details, tax profile, invoice settings) issue legal documents inline. The AI manager and the Dream Factory call those saves too. A wrong where clause or ordering could pass the new cases and leave real invoices waiting. Commit 3 adds a migration (a widened check on a table that is not hot) and a drill.
harm_if_wrong: Invoices or credit notes stop being issued for some stores, or a store-details save fails or slows because invoice issuing now runs inside it.
brief_problems: stop_if names an 'allowance for line 181' that the commit text describes only as 'Leave line expect(await issue.storesWithDocumentWork()).toContain(wait.storeId) as it is unless…'; the line number is not given there
